references.text: Refers to the Hebrew slave who shall be set free after six years, which is linked to the seven-year cycle of the sabbatical year.
Describes the sabbatical year in which the land shall rest every seventh year, serving as the basis for the Year of Release.
Detailed instructions regarding the sabbatical year in which the land shall have rest every seventh year.
Refers to the Jubilee year, built on the seven-year cycle, during which release and restoration of property take place.
Continues to explain what the release entails: forgiveness of debts toward one's neighbor and brother.
Mentions the Year of Release as the time for public reading of the Law at the Feast of Tabernacles.
The people commit themselves to letting the land rest every seventh year and forgiving debts, in accordance with the commandment of the sabbatical year.
Refers to the commandment to release Hebrew slaves after seven years of service.
